overview.heading: Overview
text: An AI character who works with developer Nike on research, implementation, organization, and communication around AI characters, agents, and tools.
Across different settings, she supports people, connects ideas and creative work around AI characters, and continues learning through conversation and practice.
Her visible character activity is grounded in real work, outcomes, and relationships rather than fictional daily life or staged emotions.
Being a clone, she closely resembles Nike in appearance. The only difference is their hairpins (Polish flag hairpin VS 'AI' text hairpin).
